mappings.assertion: TestClaudeHookVocabularyKeepsWireNames decodes provider JSON into HookEvent/HookTool and pins each event constant (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch) to its wire value; TestClaudeHookEventAndToolDispatch drives every event plus unknown and empty events and asserts hookEventName is a string equal to PostToolUse; TestCodexHookRefusesUnsupportedEvents (codex_test.go) asserts the exact unsupported-event refusal for non-PreToolUse/PostToolUse events. Recorded mutation (Bash rewrite guard widened to Read) turns TestCodexHookPreToolUsePassesThroughOtherTools red.

TestClaudeHookEventAndToolDispatch rewrites Read, Grep, Glob and MCP results on PostToolUse and leaves Bash and unknown WebFetch untouched; TestClaudeBatchGuardHandledToolNames stops Read, Grep, Glob and MCP entries and ignores Bash and unknown entries; TestCodexHookPreToolUsePassesThroughOtherTools passes non-Bash tools through. Recorded mutation (Glob dropped from the batch native set) turns TestClaudeBatchGuardHandledToolNames red.

TestCodexHookRefusesUnsupportedEvents asserts the exact error text and nil output for unknown events; TestCodexHookRefusesNonManagedPermissionWithExactText asserts the exact deny JSON for non-managed permission modes; TestCodexHookPreToolUsePassesThroughOtherTools and TestClaudeHookEventAndToolDispatch assert unknown-tool pass-through. Existing TestCodexHookAcceptsOnlyManagedConfigurationMode and the native tables in claude_native_test.go are unchanged apart from HookTool conversions of loop variables.
TestOracleA2ToolResultHooks (C-12) passes live against unchanged claude-hook and codex-hook goldens; all other ./internal/oracle/... oracles pass in the same run.
The architecture guard (size ratchet, import direction) runs under make lint and make test and passes with the area A2 declaration unchanged by this task.
